title: Start / stop station
brief: Program a conveyor with a momentary Start button and a momentary Stop button. The operator must not have to hold Start to keep the motor running.
requirements: Start PB (I0.0) is ON only while the Start button is pressed. Stop Healthy (I0.1) comes from a physically normally-closed Stop button: it is ON when released and OFF when pressed.
The Conveyor Motor (Q0.0) must initially be OFF. Pressing Start PB (I0.0) while Stop Healthy (I0.1) is ON must start the motor.
Releasing Start PB must not stop Conveyor Motor (Q0.0). The motor must continue running until the Stop button is pressed.
When Stop Healthy (I0.1) changes to OFF, Conveyor Motor (Q0.0) must stop immediately, even if Start PB is still ON. Stop takes priority.
After Stop is released again, the motor must stay OFF until Start PB is pressed again. It must not restart merely because Stop Healthy returns to ON.
objective: Understand latching, stop priority and physical switch wiring.
hints: Stop Healthy is a TRUE permissive, so use an NO ladder contact for it.
Place the Start input and motor feedback in parallel, with Stop Healthy outside the branch.
